title: 刀尖不够尖

source.kind: 历史会话 Bash 调用 local_typeset.py（CLI 参数原样）

text.title: 刀尖不够尖
text.body: 你的每个特点都展现一点，|就像那个刀，它的刀尖不够尖，|扎的就不深，别人记不住你，|一定要单独拎出来一个点，|反复地扎，才能扎的深，|别人才会记住你。
text.en: Show a little of every trait you have, and you are like a knife whose tip is not sharp enough to cut deep. You must single out one point and keep driving it in, until it goes deep and people remember.
text.credit: 原作 八大山人《二鹰图》· 水墨纸本
